Kozauer, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer and Joseph Miller as Chief Financial Officer On track for topline data readout from the pivotal Phase 3 NOVA-2 trial of LB-102 in schizophrenia in 1H 2027 Presented new preclinical data supporting LB-102’s bimodal mechanism of action at the 39 th ECNP Congress Completed a private placement of $150 million to fund expansion of LB-102 into new indications Cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments of $403.8 million as of September 30, 2026, expected to fund operations beyond Q2 2029, through multiple clinical milestones NEW YORK, November 5, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – LB Pharmaceuticals Inc (“LB Pharmaceuticals” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: LBRX), a neuromedicines company dedicated to developing and commercializing high-impact therapies that address the multiple dimensions of underserved brain disorders, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a corporate update.
We remain on track to report topline results from our Phase 3 NOVA-2 trial of LB-102 in schizophrenia in the first half of 2027.

LB-102 in Schizophrenia • Enrollment in the pivotal Phase 3 NOVA-2 trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of LB-102 in patients with acute schizophrenia continues to progress strongly with topline data expected in the first half of 2027.

LB-102 in Mood Disorders: Bipolar Depression and Adjunctive Treatment of MDD • The Phase 2 ILLUMINATE-1 trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of LB-102 in patients with bipolar 1 depression continues to enroll patients, with topline data expected in the first quarter of 2028.
• Initiation of the Phase 2 trial in the adjunctive treatment of MDD is expected in early 2027, with topline data expected in the first half of 2029.

The event highlighted new scientific insights on LB-102’s unique mechanism of action that underlies the emerging clinical profile and potential opportunity across a wide variety of brain disorders, and featured discussion of the ongoing Phase 3 trial in schizophrenia, its upcoming topline data readout, and pre-commercial planning activities.
